text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
One, two! One, two! Turn, and... That's
it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Member A
text_block_list.text: Wow! That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Member B
text_block_list.text: Sooo cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Sakura Chiyono O is teaching a
group of young Umamusume to dance
after receiving a
request from an
Umamusume club.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The steps and choreography are
important, but if you remember just one
thing, it's that you should
dance with
feeling!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You have to pour your gratitude for the
people
who support you into your
dancing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whew! I worked up a good sweat!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! Everyone worked hard and
learned
quickly! Dance really is best
paired with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: They're all such good kids...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Sorry, I just got caught up in
some
memories.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I actually used to attend this club
myself—the
Victory Club.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Victory Club helps train
Umamusume for
racing from a very
young age.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're well-known for their cheerful 
atmosphere... and, for some reason,
having a lot
of members with "Sakura" in
their names.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yep! This sure brings me back... Just like
them, I
was taught how to dance by an
older Umamusume
too.
choice_data_list: And that's where this request come...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She was so pretty and cool, and
watching her made my heart race. That's
when I decided to do
my best at dancing
too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wanted my dancing to make everyone
smile like
hers did.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... Was my lesson today as good
as hers?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! Look at me, getting all gloomy.
Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! Look at me, getting all gloomy.
Hehe...
choice_data_list: The past really is connected to th...
The past really is connected to th...
Why don't you look at the girls ar...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're right!
choice_data_list: The past really is connected to th...
The past really is connected to th...
Why don't you look at the girls ar...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I wonder if she felt the same way
I do now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get it now! Dancing is... No, it's
not just
dancing.
choice_data_list: And the children of today will pas...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Racing, singing, and everything else too! No matter how much times change, these things still exist! They're our connection to the past and future!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Miss Chiyono O! Teach us more dances,
please!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch with a warm feeling in my chest
as history unfolds and repeats, and
dance is passed down
from one
generation to the next.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
You're not doing it right! Miss Chiyono
O's
dancing was way more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Then, um... Okay! Let's try spinning
faster like she
did!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I can't believe it. I'm actually
doing it. I'm
sparkling just like my
teacher did back then.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're shining bright o...
Looks like you're shining bright o...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, here I go! I have to dazzle
them even
more!
